Cara (docs): quick heads-up — PR #8421 has a weird mismatch in the /v1/embeds/batch example.
Damon (eng): saw that. what's wrong exactly?
Cara (docs): the request example uses `items: [{id: "a", input: "..."}, ...]` but the Rust SDK snippet shows `Vec<HashMap<String, String>>` and the example response shows `embedding: {x: 0.23}` instead of an array. :grimacing:
Elena (sdk): oh no, we surfaced a hand-translated snippet from an old client. Rust should use `Vec<String>` or `Vec<EmbeddingInput>` not a map. Also response `embedding` must be `[f32, f32, ...]` per runtime output.
Samir (qa): I noticed customers failing integration tests because our example response JSON is invalid (embedding object vs array). Filing repro now.
Cara (docs): proposed edits in the PR: update the request example to `inputs: [{"id":"a","text":"..."}]`, swap Rust snippet to `Vec<EmbeddingInput>` with a typed struct, and change response sample to show `embedding: [0.23, -0.01, ...]`.
Damon (eng): fine, but double-check header expectations. The docs example uses `X-Request-Meta: user=abc` while the runtime expects `x-request-meta` lowercase. We should note header case-insensitivity but keep sample lowercase to match our middleware logs.
Elena (sdk): I'll push a corrected Rust code block. Suggest adding a short note about batching semantics: server accepts up to 512 items, but backend shards prefer chunking at 64. That avoids people copying unbounded loops.
Cara (docs): good call. Also add a tiny migration note: prior API returned embeddings as objects for single-item responses (legacy) — clarify that batch always returns arrays.
docs-bot: PR #8421 updated by Cara (docs): added rust snippet, fixed response example, added batching note.
Samir (qa): running quick smoke now.
Samir (qa): smoke green against staging.
Damon (eng): LGTM from infra side. Two requests: 1) add a short CI test expectation we can keep (simple schema assertion), 2) include a link to the runtime behaviour doc (internal) about header normalization.
Cara (docs): will do both, pushing final patch in a few mins. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Elena (sdk): when you push, ping me and I'll cut a quick patch for the SDK examples generator to avoid regeneration regressions.
Cara (docs): pinged in PR comment. closing thread once CI passes.
